author: metalsandman999
body:
Matty's Patty's in Costa Mesa is pretty good for smash burgers and tallow fries.

Storico Spaghetteria in Tustin is a little pretentious but the food is good and service is friendly.

First Class Pizza (small chain) is the closest thing to 1990's cartoon pizza I've come across in real life (see photo), and reasonably priced.

Sake 2 Me AYCE sushi in Tustin is great (the one on Newport, not Carroll - they stopped AYCE years ago).

Toast (Tustin, Brea) is good for trendy breakfast.

Panda Bowl in Fountain Valley and Mr. Wok in Lake Forest are great for hole-in-the-wall, greasy Chinese takeout (RIP China Run).

White Sparrow in Tustin and TruBru in Orange are great coffee shops (the latter better for hanging out because it's bigger with lots of chairs).
